validation: Every unique stored object verified by ZIP CRC, length and SHA256.
index_validation: Every INDEX row was re-read and matched by byte count and SHA256; 4,235 original evidence paths preserved.
index_format: INDEX.json files[].path -> files[].stored_path; MANIFEST.json lists unique objects and excluded execution products. restore.py verifies each row before restoring.
scope: Separate evidence ZIP; not for source bundle. Executable, PE, object, library archive and LLVM build products are excluded, with hashes retained.
